| **AbaQuest 1** |  |
|  ![][image1]  | Should all the tiles for students are teachers be on the same page and line? Perhaps a hierarchy for teachers When we have 20 students, how will the profiles be displayed?  |
|                        ![][image2] | This is a great model of the junior counter.   The answer rod: which is the middle black horizontal bar  needs to be more pronounced, wider, thicker and the same color as the vertical bar (which is grey). I also really enjoy the sound effects of the bead movement. It makes it more engaging. There is some difficulty with getting the beads to move away from the answer rod. |
| ![][image3] | The teacher portal is great\! |
| ![][image4] | This may  be a placeholder pre-test question.  There is a delay after clicking a selection. This screen can actually be skipped, unless there some thought behind it that I’m not aware of |
|                                  ![][image5] | I prefer the design used on the opening screen. |
| ![][image6] | The story mode should appear prior to this screen where the students hear/ see story characters share the names of their junior counters. Here’s the screen shot of Quest 1 ![][image7] |
| ![][image8] | I think the confirmation button should have more kid friendly wording, like: Start My Quest\! Let’s Go\! I love the ‘create your own option’- Could the name be read out when kids hover over it- for struggling readers? It does populate whatever name has been selected, which may be confusing if I’m selected the ‘create your own name’ option |
| ![][image9] | These 3 questions may be a place holder- but can be eliminated. Below is the post test for AbaQuest-1 ![][image10] |
| **What’s missing from AbaQuest-1** |  |
